doc.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024

title: Goodbyes and birthday wishes
summary: Rowe requests 'Once in a While' and they exchange thanks and goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I hope you have a wonderful gig this afternoon and I’m going to put in a request for “Once in a While.”
And I especially hope your gig on Friday, which is your birthday — maybe you could play “Happy Birthday” in all twelve keys, see if anybody notices.

Oh twelve — you know I’ve never counted how many there are. I definitely avoid certain ones. But thank you. I — you know, I play it as safe as I can. You? I don’t know, it’s your fault, you’re just so easy to talk with. [sings] “You’d be so easy to talk with.”
All right. I’d love to see you live and thanks a lot.
I’ll just pause this and we’ll say our good-byes.
